note: Round-29 planning sweep. Relevant hits only (OR-noise discarded; see raw/README.md). Focus: (1) the model class for short-window financial forecasting — from-scratch transformers vs linear/MLP vs small pretrained time-series foundation models, and the deep+evolutionary failure post-mortem; (2) where a genuine crypto edge is documented — 15-minute reversal, crypto factor models, funding/basis carry; (3) adaptation/regime (test-time adaptation, online changepoint); (4) evaluation robustness (Sharpe vs sampling frequency, publication/selection bias, configuration-robust protocols). the grounding notes are docs/research/round29-*.md and the plan is docs/PLAN-round29.md.

model_class.title: Are Transformers Effective for Time Series Forecasting?
model_class.why: DLinear: a one-layer linear model beats the LTSF transformer family; self-attention is permutation-invariant so sub-series tokens lose temporal order. The mechanism behind a tiny attention controller's negative skill — round-29 P1.

model_class.title: Do We Really Need Deep Learning Models for Time Series Forecasting?
model_class.why: A plain GBRT matches the deep models — the deep model's complexity buys no accuracy.

model_class.title: TSMixer: An All-MLP Architecture for Time Series Forecasting
model_class.why: Time+feature MLP mixing matches the specialised SOTA; the MLP-mixer arm of P1.

model_class.title: TSMixer: Lightweight MLP-Mixer Model for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
model_class.why: The production MLP-mixer variant (IBM) — cheap and strong.

model_class.title: Long-term Forecasting with TiDE: Time-series Dense Encoder
model_class.why: A dense encoder/decoder with residual MLP, no attention, competitive with transformers.

model_class.title: N-BEATS: Neural basis expansion analysis for interpretable time series forecasting
model_class.why: MLP residual stack with an interpretable decomposition — the third linear/MLP reference class.

model_class.title: A Temporal Linear Network for Time Series Forecasting
model_class.why: The linear line continued — evidence that a purely temporal linear model is a serious baseline.

model_class.title: Tiny Time Mixers (TTMs): Fast Pre-trained Models for Enhanced Zero/Few-Shot Forecasting of Multivariate Time Series
model_class.why: A 1M-parameter PRETRAINED TSFM on TSMixer; the zero-shot arm of P1.

model_class.title: Tiny-TSM: Efficiently Training a Lightweight SOTA Time Series Foundation Model
model_class.why: 23M params, one GPU-week, synthetic corpus (SynthTS), SOTA without NAS/tuning — the corpus (not the parameter count) is the lever.

model_class.title: Chronos: Learning the Language of Time Series
model_class.why: Value tokenisation + T5 backbone + cross-entropy pretraining; zero-shot on 42 datasets.

model_class.title: Chronos-2: From Univariate to Universal Forecasting
Unified Training of Universal Time Series Forecasting Transformers (Moirai)
Moirai 2.0: When Less Is More for Time Series Forecasting
model_class.why: Decoder-only + quantile loss beats the larger v1 — smaller, simpler, better.

model_class.title: In-Context Fine-Tuning for Time-Series Foundation Models
model_class.why: Prompt a pretrained TSFM with multiple example series at inference instead of fitting — the few-shot route for a tiny-data regime.

model_class.title: Scaling Transformers for Time Series Forecasting: Do Pretrained Large Models Outperform Small-Scale Alternatives?
model_class.why: The exact audit round-29 P1 should run cheaply on NeuLegion's own data.

model_class.title: Forecasting Realized Volatility with Time Series Foundation Models: A Comparison with Econometric Benchmarks
model_class.why: Domain-scoped reality check: nine zero-shot TSFMs vs eight econometric specs (HAR) on 50 assets — TSFMs are tested, not crowned.

model_class.title: Trading with the Momentum Transformer: An Intelligent and Interpretable Architecture
model_class.why: Attention beats TS-momentum benchmarks NET OF COST and adapts to regimes — but learned over a long history, not per 60-bar fold. The optimistic case, scoped.

model_class.title: Supervised Autoencoder MLP for Financial Time Series Forecasting
model_class.why: A small MLP with representation learning on financial data — the finance-native MLP baseline.

model_class.title: The Red Queen's Trap: Limits of Deep Evolution in High-Frequency Trading
model_class.why: CENTRAL WARNING: a rigorous post-mortem of a genetic-survival + LSTM/Transformer trading system — the closest external test of the evolutionary-hivemind bet; grounds NOT wiring legion/evolve.js.

crypto_edges.title: Short-horizon mean reversion in cryptocurrency markets: a matched cross-market measurement
crypto_edges.why: CENTRAL: at 15-minute horizons 90% of 183 Binance pairs carry significant directional reversal vs 2.7% of 187 US stocks/ETFs, in every focal coin-year since 2021; the signal lives in SIGNS, not magnitudes. The strongest external lead for round-29 P3.

crypto_edges.title: Cryptoasset Factor Models
crypto_edges.why: Factor models for the cross-section of daily crypto returns, with source code and out-of-sample backtests, on a wide coin/token universe.

crypto_edges.title: A Time-Varying Network for Cryptocurrencies
crypto_edges.why: Return cross-predictability and technological similarity drive a time-varying latent-community network — the conditional cross-sectional structure.

crypto_edges.title: Deep Learning Statistical Arbitrage
crypto_edges.why: Arbitrage portfolios as residual portfolios from CONDITIONAL latent factors, then signals on the residuals — the construction a cross-sectional sleeve must use (and the one that leaves only ~1% residual at 1h in this basket).

crypto_edges.title: Quantifying Cryptocurrency Unpredictability: A Comprehensive Study of Complexity and Forecasting
crypto_edges.why: Complexity vs forecastability across BTC/ETH/LTC/BNB/XRP — a humility check on how much is predictable at all.

crypto_edges.title: Review of deep learning models for crypto price prediction: implementation and evaluation
crypto_edges.why: The survey baseline for what actually replicates in crypto price forecasting.

crypto_edges.title: CTBench: Cryptocurrency Time Series Generation Benchmark
crypto_edges.why: The first crypto-specific TS-generation benchmark (452 tokens) with trading-aware evaluation — a data/augmentation resource.

crypto_edges.title: Dynamic Multi-Pair Trading Strategy in Cryptocurrency Markets with Deep Reinforcement Learning
crypto_edges.why: Pair trading in crypto with DRL as an execution overlay; evidence on pair divergence risk in high-variance markets.

crypto_edges.title: Optimal market-neutral currency trading on the cryptocurrency platform
crypto_edges.why: A multivariate pair-trading bucket with a bi-objective (profit vs risk) convex formulation — market-neutral by construction, backtested 2020-2022 including a bear run.

crypto_edges.title: Designing funding rates for perpetual futures in cryptocurrency markets
crypto_edges.why: Funding <-> price alignment modelled with path-dependent BSDEs and replicating portfolios — the structural mechanics that make funding a carry return.

crypto_edges.title: BitMEX Funding Correlation with Bitcoin Exchange Rate
crypto_edges.why: Funding is Granger-causal with the inverse perp price and heteroskedastic — funding as a distinct, predictable information channel; the independence lead for P4.

crypto_edges.title: Funding-Aware Optimal Market Making for Perpetual DEXs
crypto_edges.why: Funding as a first-class return driver in perpetual markets.

crypto_edges.title: Optimal Adaptive Market Making: A Theoretical Framework for High-Yield Liquidity Provision in Perpetual Futures Markets

adaptation_and_regime.title: Test-Time Adaptation for Non-stationary Time Series: From Synthetic Regime Shifts to Financial Markets
adaptation_and_regime.why: CENTRAL for P5: a frozen backbone with ONLY normalization affine parameters updated on recent unlabeled windows, for causal forecasting and direction classification, moving from synthetic regime shifts to financial markets — the antidote to schedule-bound retraining.

adaptation_and_regime.title: Accurate Parameter-Efficient Test-Time Adaptation for Time Series Forecasting (PETSA)
adaptation_and_regime.why: Low-rank adapters + dynamic gating with a robust/frequency/patch-structural loss — the parameter-efficient TTA recipe.

adaptation_and_regime.title: Towards Principled Test-Time Adaptation for Time Series Forecasting
adaptation_and_regime.why: The design-principles framing for TTA in forecasting.

adaptation_and_regime.title: Battling the Non-stationarity in Time Series Forecasting via Test-time Adaptation
DeePM: Regime-Robust Deep Learning for Systematic Macro Portfolio Management
adaptation_and_regime.why: Names the 'ragged filtration' problem and answers it with a Directed Delay (Causal Sieve) trained to a robust risk-adjusted utility — the finance-native version of causal-sieve adaptation.

adaptation_and_regime.title: Adaptive Financial Transformer with Regime-Gated Attention for Stock Return Prediction
Adaptive and Regime-Aware RL for Portfolio Optimization
Bayesian Online Changepoint Detection

adaptation_and_regime.title: Robust and Scalable Bayesian Online Changepoint Detection

adaptation_and_regime.why: A four-state non-homogeneous HMM distinguishes bull/bear/calm regimes and beats a single-regime random walk in one-step forecast density — crypto-specific evidence for a regime-switching reference class.

adaptation_and_regime.title: Expectile hidden Markov regression models for analyzing cryptocurrency returns
adaptation_and_regime.why: Heavier-tailed regime model for crypto returns.

adaptation_and_regime.title: Quantile and expectile copula-based hidden Markov regression models for the analysis of the cryptocurrency market

online_and_no_regret.why: The OPS taxonomy (Follow-the-Winner/Loser, Pattern-Matching, Meta-Learning) and the capital-growth framework.
